scope: Inventory templates for new local profiles. live-like starts as starter and takes the live account at Sync Inventory, with owned premium warbonds open. unlock-all is a development profile that grants every non-consumable catalogue item, including content the account may not own, and every booster.

live-like.description: Like your live account: a starter profile until you run Sync Inventory, which then brings in your level, unlocks, ship, medals and samples, and opens the premium warbonds you own.

starter.description: Fresh player after basic training: AR-23 Liberator, P-2 Peacemaker, G-12 High Explosive (the onboarding chain's unlock items and the stratagems every account owns, Orbital Precision Strike and MG-43 Machine Gun, are added by ProfileStore).

unlock-all.description: Development: every non-consumable catalogue item, every booster and package progress, at the top level (300; customization needs level 10).
